output.tldr: Trent delivers robust top-line and operating profit compounding with high cash conversion, though valuation and inventory risks warrant continued monitoring.

promises.promise: Demand traction for small ticket discretionary lifestyle categories over medium term
promises.actual: Q3 FY26 consolidated revenue grew 14.8% YoY to Rs 5,345 cr with 20% operating margin.
promises.why: Revenue expansion and high operating margins support positive demand claims.

promises.promise: Newer markets become more relevant over a two-to-three year period
promises.actual: Q3 FY26 saw 17 Westside and 48 Zudio store additions expanding footprint.
promises.why: Store count expansion validates multi-year market penetration strategy.

promises.promise: Deepen competitive moat by growing relevance of brands across target audiences
promises.actual: Westside online revenues grew 38% contributing over 6% of brand revenues.
promises.why: Digital channel growth and store rollouts show deepening brand relevance.

promises.promise: Demand traction aided for small ticket discretionary lifestyle categories over medium term
promises.actual: Q2 FY26 consolidated revenue reached Rs 4,818 cr with 17% operating margin.
promises.why: Revenue growth continued despite management noting muted overall consumer sentiment.

promises.promise: Scale store presence and fashion concepts across formats
promises.actual: Fashion concepts expanded store count to 248 stores and Trends reached 765.
promises.why: Physical store footprints scaled aggressively as claimed by management.

credibility.line: Management provides conservative qualitative guidance and consistently delivers solid store expansions and financial compounding without overpromising metrics.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights robust store additions and expansion across concepts.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Q3 FY26 store additions included 17 Westside and 48 Zudio outlets.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management notes low single-digit like-for-like growth in fashion.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Consolidated revenue still grew 15.9% YoY in Q2 FY26 to Rs 4,818 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management emphasizes high growth in online revenues for Westside.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Westside online grew 38% in Q3 FY26, contributing >6% of brand revenues.

bull.point: Exceptional compounding power with operating profit growing faster than revenue.
bull.evidence: 3-year operating profit CAGR is 49.8% versus 34.5% for revenue.

bull.point: High cash conversion quality confirming reported profits are real.
bull.evidence: CFO to PAT 5-year ratio stands at 1.23x.

bull.point: Margin expansion through operating leverage and disciplined efficiency.
bull.evidence: Operating margin expanded to 20% in Q3 FY26.

bear.point: Large inventory exposure representing key audit risk.
bear.evidence: Inventories represent 17.81% of total assets at Rs 2,177.87 cr.

bear.point: Muted underlying fashion store comparable growth.
bear.evidence: Like-for-like growth for the fashion portfolio was in low single digits.

bear.point: Existing contingent tax liabilities pose secondary cash outflow risks.
bear.evidence: Income tax contingent liabilities stand at Rs 79.07 cr.

watch_next: Track like-for-like growth recovery in fashion formats.
Monitor inventory levels relative to total assets.
